faq: Will the redesign hurt my search rankings?
We aim to protect them by keeping page addresses, titles and text where possible and testing before launch. Big layout changes can still move rankings a little, and no one can promise otherwise.
Do I need to give you a design?
No. Send a few sites you like and your brand colors and we propose the look. If you already have a design in Figma, we build from that.
Can you keep my current theme?
Often, yes, if it is well made. If it is slow or outdated we suggest a lighter one and show you why before changing anything.
Will the site go down during the redesign?
No. We work on a staging copy and your live site stays untouched until you approve, so visitors see no break while the work is underway.

desc:
A tired design makes a good business look careless. Ecom Swift LLC delivers a WordPress website redesign that gives your site a fresh, fast look while keeping your text, page addresses and search setup in place.

## What is a WordPress website redesign?

A WordPress website redesign changes how the site looks and feels, including layouts, fonts, colors, images, header and footer, while keeping the content and the address of each page. It is different from a rebuild, where everything starts again.

The goal is a site that looks current, reads easily on a phone and gives visitors a clear next step, without losing the work already done.

## Why design age matters

Visitors judge a site in a few seconds, and they judge the business with it. Dated fonts, crowded sidebars, tiny buttons and photos that do not match each other suggest a business that is not paying attention. On a phone, an old layout may need pinching and zooming, and many people simply leave.

Design also carries practical weight. Navigation that confuses visitors hides your services. Heavy images slow every page. A modern, simple layout puts the important things where people look first.

## How a redesign affects results

A redesign works through clarity and trust. When the menu is simple, visitors find services faster. When photos are sharp and consistent, the business looks established. When buttons are large and clear, more visitors reach the contact page.

Keeping your existing addresses and search titles matters. Pages that already appear in search listings keep their place in the structure, so you are not starting from nothing. A redesign changes presentation, and results still depend on your content, your market and how people find you.

## What a good redesign includes

- A review of current pages to decide what stays, what moves and what goes.
- A defined set of fonts, colors and button styles used across every page.
- A redesigned home page that explains what you do in the first screen.
- A new header, menu and footer that work on phones.
- Images refreshed and compressed for faster loading.
- Layouts for blog posts and the contact page.
- Existing page addresses and search titles left in place.
- Custom sections and icons that fit your brand, in larger packages.
- A speed pass on the finished pages.
- Before and after screenshots to show the change.

## How we work

We study your current site and agree a direction with you, using examples of styles you like. We then build the new design on a private staging copy, so your live site stays untouched while we work.

You review the staging site and send feedback. When you approve, we move the new design live and check every main page on desktop and phone. Basic redesigns the home page and one inner page. Standard covers your main pages, with a new header and footer. Premium goes across the site with custom sections and a speed pass. Add-ons include a logo refresh, photo sourcing and extra pages.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Collect examples of sites whose look you like.
- Gather your logo files and best photos in advance.
- Decide which pages matter most and start with them.
- Open the staging copy on your personal mobile before approving it.
- Keep your page text accurate and current.

**Avoid:**
- Changing page addresses without a reason and a redirect.
- Crowding the front page with rotating banners and overlay windows.
- Using stock photos that do not look like your business.
- Mixing more than two or three fonts.
- Approving the design without checking the mobile view.

## Who it is for

Owners whose site still looks like it did several years ago will see the clearest change. Businesses that have grown and now sell more services than the site shows can use the redesign to reorganize them. So can anyone who has had a new logo or brand and wants the website to match.

## How to get started

Share your website address, examples of designs you like and any brand files you have. We never need your password. We work through a collaborator or administrator user in WordPress and your hosting account, and you can remove that access when the project ends. We can keep your current theme if it suits the new design.
